status.summary: Fees, prizes and hotels added for Sitges, Hastings, Graz, Cappelle, Vardaris, Sligo, Prague Open and Jersey. Bled: rating limit 2300.

sitges-2026.changes: Entry fee and prize list added: €89, or free with a 10-night hotel stay. 1st prize €5,000.

fields.fee: €89. Free if you stay 10+ nights at the official hotel or Sunway apartments. Free for GMs and players rated 2450+.

details.prize: Group A prize fund €23,750, 1st prize €5,000 + trophy. Rating prize 2300–2449: €300 / €225 / €150 (not added to main prizes).

hotels.name: Hotel Sunway Playa Golf / Sunway apartments (official)
hotels.note: Prices are not public; book via the organiser (info@sunwaychessfestival.com, +34 93 811 34 10). Staying 10+ nights makes the entry free.

hastings-2026.changes: Venue, prize fund and round times added (from the 2025/26 edition).

fields.fee: Free for GMs/IMs. FM fee is not published; ask HICCchairman@yahoo.com.

details.venue: Horntye Park Sports Complex, Bohemia Road, Hastings (2025/26)
details.schedule: 2025/26 pattern: R1 28 Dec 15:00 · double rounds on 29 Dec, 30 Dec and 1 Jan · last round in the morning. 2026/27: R1 28 Dec, R9 5 Jan.

graz-2027.changes: Entry fee and prize fund added (from previous edition).

fields.fee: Open A: €75 (2024 rate), +€15 if you pay late. Free only for GMs and IMs.

hotels.name: Overnight packages via chessgraz.com
hotels.note: Prices not published in the regulations.

cappelle-2027.changes: Entry fee, prize fund and schedule added (from 2025 rules).

fields.fee: €50 (€60 if you pay late). Free only for GMs, IMs, WGMs and WIMs (2025 rules).

details.schedule: 2025 pattern: R1 Saturday 16:00, last round Friday 10:00. Register on site before 12:00 on day 1.
details.venue: Palais des Arts et des Loisirs, Place Bernard Gouvart, Cappelle-la-Grande. Free DK'Bus shuttles from Dunkirk.

hotels.name: Hotels in Dunkirk (tourist office)
hotels.note: The organiser lists no hotel offer; free buses run from Dunkirk.

vardaris-2027.changes: Format found: 7 rounds, and players rated 2300+ play free.

fields.fee: Open A: free for titled players and players rated 2300+ (2025 rules).
fields.note: Only 7 rounds, so it can't give a norm. 2025 venue: Holiday Inn Thessaloniki. Prize fund €4,350, 1st prize €1,000.

details.venue: Hotel Holiday Inn, 8 Monastiriou St, Thessaloniki (2025)

sligo-2027.changes: 2026 format found: the Masters was only 5 rounds.

fields.note: In 2026 the Masters was a 5-round weekend event (30 players, €65–85 entry, 1st prize €825) and there was also a separate 9-round Open. Check which section has 9 rounds in 2027.

bled-2027.changes: Warning: in 2026 the main tournament was only for players rated up to 2300.

fields.tc: 75 min + 15 min after move 40, +30 s per move
fields.note: In 2026 the main tournament was only for players rated up to 2300, so at 2306 you probably can't enter. Ask bled@sah-ljubljana.si before planning.

hotels.name: Hotel Park 4* (package: double room, full board, 6 nights)
hotels.note: 2026 package for groups of 6+ through federations.

prague-open-2027.changes: Organiser fee rules added (same organiser as Marienbad).

fields.fee: Not published yet. The same organiser (AVE Chess) charged an FM about €31–64 in the open and about €190–230 in an IM round robin at Marienbad/Pilsen.

jersey-2027.changes: Venue added. GM and IM norms possible.

details.venue: Hotel Ambassadeur, St Clement Bay, Jersey (2025)
